rca of the issue: SERIALIZATION-STRIP BUG — reproduction: (1) POST /api/auth/login as admin, (2) PUT /api/bot/config json={monte_carlo_paths: 7500, liquidity_gate_mode: 'advisory'} → 200 but response has NEITHER field, (3) mongo shell find_one({user_id: admin.id}) → both fields ARE persisted, (4) GET /api/bot/config → response STILL missing both fields. Root cause: bot_routes.py:82 _serialize(cfg) returns a hand-crafted dict of 43 keys that has not been extended since iter-40, so all iter-52..114 fields are structurally invisible to the API's response layer. Mitigation options (choose ONE): (a) Replace _serialize() with `{k: (str(v) if k=='_id' else v) for k,v in cfg.items() if k != '_id'} | {'id': str(cfg['_id'])}` — pass-through everything, (b) derive the whitelist from `set(BotConfigUpdate.model_fields.keys()) | {'id','user_id','account_id','updated_at'}`, or (c) manually add the ~20 missing keys to the existing whitelist and add a unit test that diffs BotConfigUpdate.__fields__ against _serialize's key set.
